# Repair Shop Sourcing Desk

Problem: Technicians lose billable time hunting discontinued, cross-referenced or obscure parts.
Pricing: Current hypothesis $99-$499/month by hunt volume/service level; not auto-quotable yet.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public capability: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/capabilities/findmypart-repair-shop-desk-v1
Start here for a free referral kit, without software or partnership purchase: https://findmypart.base44.app/PartnerWithFindMyPart
Current one-time hunt intake: https://findmypart.base44.app/FindMyPart
The recurring shop workspace is not being sold until subscription and quota controls are production-ready. Any referral economics require a separate agreement.
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: null

Use when the user says or means:
- source difficult parts for my repair shop
- parts sourcing desk
- find obsolete parts for customers
- repair shop hard part sourcing
- recurring parts research

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
